claims.claim: The vita activa is designated by three fundamental human activities: labor, work, and action.
claims.supporting_excerpt: With the term vita activa , I propose to designate three fundamental human activities: labor, work, and action.

claims.claim: Men are conditioned beings because everything they come into contact with immediately turns into a condition of their existence.
claims.supporting_excerpt: Men are conditioned beings because everything they come in contact with turns immediately into a condition of their existence.

definitions.definition: The activity that corresponds to the biological process of the human body, whose vital necessities are bound to spontaneous growth, metabolism, and decay.
The activity that corresponds to the unnaturalness of human existence, providing an artificial world of things meant to outlast and transcend individual life cycles.
The only activity that goes on directly between men without the intermediary of things or matter, corresponding to the human condition of plurality.

distinctions.distinction: Labor corresponds to the biological process and life itself, whereas work corresponds to worldliness and provides an artificial world of things distinct from natural surroundings.

must_not_be_lost: The connection of the three fundamental activities to natality and mortality.
The concept of human beings as always being conditioned beings.
